motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Corson , to approve Consent Agenda items 3-A through 3-D.
Seeing no objection, the Boulder City Council adjourned and the General Canvassing and Election Board convened.
Seeing no objection, Will Toor was appointed the Chair of the General Canvassing and Election Board.
Board member Corson moved, seconded by Morzel, to approve the abstract and result sheets of the November 7, 2000 General Municipal Election for the City of Boulder.
Seeing no objection the General Canvassing and Election Board for the General Municipal Election adjourned and the Boulder City Council reconvened.
Councilmember Corson moved, seconded by Morzel to approve Sections 1.01 to 3.20 of revised Boulder Valley Comprehensive Plan (BVCP) policies for the five-year update as amended.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7-1. Lopez opposed. Havlick absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Morzel moved, seconded by Mock to table to 11/21/00, Sections 4.01 to 8.1 of revised Boulder Valley Comprehensive Plan (BVCP) policies for the five-year update.

Councilmember Lopez moved, seconded by Corson to consider a resolution finding the annexation petition in compliance with state statutes and establishing December 19, 2000 as the date for a public hearing..
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7-0. Poinsatte and Havlick absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Corson, to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No.7098 to annex and zone the subject property to Rural Residential Established (RR-E).

Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Corson, to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No.7099 to annex and zone the subject property to Rural Residential- Established (RR-E), and a minor amendment to the Boulder Valley Comprehensive Plan (BVCP) Area I, Area II, Area III map, to change designation from Area IIB to IIA for this property.
Councilmember Corson moved, seconded by Morzel, to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7100 formingthe Forest Glen Eco Pass General Improvement District.

Councilmember Corson moved, seconded by Lopez, to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7101 approving and authorizing the issuance of Boulder Municipal Property Authority Lease Purchase Revenue Notes, Series 2001A, in the aggregate principal amount of $545,000.00 and approving and authorizing a Lease Purchase Agreement for the purchase of 53.37 acres in fee together with all mineral rights and 13 shares of Left Hand Ditch located at Nelson Road and N. 39 th Avenue from the LaVerne Johnson Trust for Open Space purposes.

Councilmember Corson moved, seconded by Lopez, to introduce and order published by title only emergency Ordinance No. 7102 adopting Supplement No. 66 which codifies previously adopted Ordinance Nos. 7062, 7079, 7080, and 7081, as an amendment.
There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 10:34 p.m.

open_comment_speakers.name: Ed Zolnick

open_comment_speakers.name: Robert W. Law

open_comment_speakers.name: Robert Sharp

open_comment_speakers.name: Susie Rankin
open_comment_speakers.topic: Part of Global Response. Praise to Nature’s Own business donating 100% of proceeds from now until Thanksgiving.
